content: To investigate these questions, we run the same fine-tuning using the copy-marked, backtrans-nmt and backtrans-nmt setups. Note that except for the last one, all training scenarios have access to same target training data. We intend to see whether the overall performance of the NMT system degrades when we selectively freeze certain sets of parameters, meaning that they are not updated during fine-tuning.
